sections.Profile:
Big Hit," introduced in July 1952, is a single-player electro-mechanical (EM) pinball machine. This game includes two flippers, one pop bumper, seven scoring bumpers, two captive balls, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1952
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Baseball, Sports, Original Theme
